main_topics.reason: The user opened with the conflict between exercise advice and being unable to function for days after walking or yoga, and returned to how to avoid another crash.
The user explored starting at a very small level, holding back on good days, and gradually building activity across several turns.
The user described overdoing activity on good days to make up for bad ones and then crashing, and said the framing of capping activity was useful.
The user asked whether walking or yoga was better and responded that a community-center pool might be doable.
The user said they felt stuck between general advice and their body's response, and described feeling punished for trying.
The user asked how long it might take to notice a difference and accepted that progress could take weeks to months.

output.summary: The user described delayed flares after walking or beginner yoga despite repeated advice to exercise, and asked how to find a tolerable approach. The assistant discussed very small starting amounts, pacing on good days, warm-water movement, and gradual progress; the user said the advice was genuinely useful and that a pool might be doable. The user ended appreciative and described the conversation as more helpful than many appointments.
